scope: 3 chest alternatives plus 13 furnishing/shipboard props; Human excluded
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW review-only sprite atlas for Great Voyage, 2048x2048 square, FOUR columns by FOUR rows, exactly SIXTEEN separate objects with generous transparent gutters. No text or numbers, no scene, no human parts.
INPUT IMAGE ROLE: supplied six-object atlas is a STYLE AND VIEW REFERENCE ONLY for retained woodgrain, navy cloth, brass palette and restrained painted surface details. Do NOT copy its existing chest design. Its large backdrop/halos and chunky furniture construction are NOT desired.
NEW DESIGN DIRECTION: maritime Age of Sail furnishings with restrained Victorian decorative craftsmanship, a stylized game-world blend rather than a historical accuracy claim. Fine antique brass escutcheons, carved timber panels, leather straps and elegant practical joinery. Rich but readable material surfaces; never ornate noise or fantasy treasure piles.
EXACT CELL CONTENTS, left to right:
ROW 1: (1) NEW captain's sea chest: dark walnut, subtly curved low lid, recessed timber panel, delicate pierced brass corner fittings and keyhole escutcheon, leather side handles, NO broad parallel metal straps across lid; (2) alternative Victorian campaign traveling trunk: oxblood leather-covered timber, slender brass edging and small corner guards, twin short buckled leather closures, flat lid, refined proportions; (3) alternative Age of Sail oak strongbox: slightly arched paneled lid, slender dark wrought-iron hinge scrolls, compact brass lock plate, no oversized rivets; (4) compact wooden writing bureau with closed drawers and a clear writing surface.
ROW 2: (5) slim walnut wardrobe with paneled doors; (6) low wooden bookcase with restrained colored book spines; (7) small rectangular mess table, clean wood top; (8) simple two-seat wooden bench.
ROW 3: (9) round wooden stool; (10) ivory canvas hammock with short rope suspension ends; (11) wooden washstand with ivory ceramic basin and small jug; (12) freestanding brass and iron ship lantern, unlit, no glow.
ROW 4: (13) closed oak provision barrel with restrained iron hoops; (14) wooden shipping crate with subtle diagonal brace; (15) neatly coiled hemp rope; (16) compact carpenter's workbench with a hand plane and mallet resting on it.
RENDERING CONTRACT: Stylized hand-painted 2D game assets, simple readable silhouettes and restrained natural surface shading. Preserve directional timber grain, subtle wood color changes, fine cloth/leather texture and small brass/iron tone variations. THIN CONSISTENT-WIDTH SINGLE DARK CONTOURS, approximately 1-2 px at this resolution; no heavy black rims, double outlines, glowing edge bleed or bevel-outline sandwiches. Slim frames and restrained corners, not chunky toy furniture. Avoid deep shadows, excessive side faces, inflated proportions, smooth plastic gradients, clean vector fills and generic noise texture.
VIEW: all sixteen share the reference's near-top-down orthographic 2D game viewpoint and consistent screen axes. Keep visible side depth minimal; no isometric 3/4 showcase perspective. Preserve identifiable top surfaces and shallow front edges where needed, especially chest closures. Use consistent gentle upper-left lighting without scene cast shadows.
COMPOSITION: exactly one object per cell, each wholly inside its conceptual 512x512 cell with at least 32px clear gutter, no overlap. Relative category sizing coherent; tiny objects may be enlarged moderately for review but no extra accessories beyond specified attached components. No captions, labels, watermark, frame, tile floor behind objects or background.
ALPHA: true transparent background, empty gaps fully transparent, clean edges, NO brown atmospheric backdrop or colored shadow clouds from the reference, NO checkerboard baked in. The entire output is a review atlas, not an applied asset. Human characters and body parts strictly excluded.
observations: Sixteen objects visible in requested four-by-four arrangement.
Generation requested 2048 square; actual dimensions must be taken from saved PNG metadata.
Several furnishings expose substantial front/side faces. View normalization remains necessary before product adoption.
No Unity import, slicing, prefab edits or gameplay validation performed. Full alpha-edge cleanup suitability is unverified.
